6a7a1ff83dbea7fa8c86b5ac.text: The radial probability distribution curve (plot of 4 r^2 R^2 versus r ) for a particular atomic orbital of a hydrogen-like species exhibits exactly 3 peaks. If this orbital possesses exactly 1 angular node, what is its designation?
